updates.title: Magnetic Catch Demo v1.0.4
updates.content:
Small update on the demo with mostly quality of life implementations :)

**General**

- Sell All Button: Added a button to quickly sell all cleaned items.
- Bug Fix: Fixed an issue where the bicycle didn't show up in the craftable tab (Notebook).
- Audio: New music tracks added to two environments! 🎵
- UI: Added a scroll view for when your inventory gets too full.

**Minigame**

- Visual Polish: Fixed the pull bar so it no longer clips outside of its container.
- QoL: The "perfect hit" area is now clearly visible.

**Skill Tree**

- Upgrade 1: Added a skill that helps you get those last remaining legendary items.
- Upgrade 2: Perfect hits now reward you with stamina.

**Localization**

- Spanish: Spanish translations are now live! Special thanks to FRAGMENTEDBRAIN (check out the Credits).

If you have any other feedback, feel free to comment below or consider leaving the game a review!

Have a great catch! 🧲🎣
